new_series.title: Money for Nothing
new_series.synopsis: Expert upcycler Sarah Moore calls on woodworking legend Norman Wilkinson for his biggest ever challenge... a smashed-up organ.

new_series.title: RuPaul's Drag Race UK
new_series.synopsis: A hot new cast of queens enter the werkroom as RuPaul kicks off the legendary race. Thandiwe Newton joins Michelle Visage and Alan Carr on the judging panel.

new_series.title: Intrigue
new_series.synopsis: When two Saudi men with no English and no income want to rent a flat in San Diego, an Arabic-speaking neighbour offers help.

new_series.title: A Working Mother by Agnes Owens
new_series.synopsis: Ten years after the Second World War, Betty is married to a troubled veteran who barely looks after their two children while she earns a wage.

new_series.title: You Do Not Have to Say Anything
new_series.synopsis: From high-octane car chases (rare) to being arrested lying in your own bed (common), arrests mean the same thing - a shift from person to suspect, ordinary citizen to ‘the accused’

new_series.title: The Skewer
new_series.synopsis: A twisted comedy treat. The news remixed. Jon Holmes presents The Skewer. Headphones on.

new_series.title: The News Quiz
new_series.synopsis: Andy Zaltzman is back for a brand new series of The News Quiz, with panellists including Alasdair Beckett-King, Coco Khan and Kyrah Gray.

new_series.title: Your Mum
new_series.synopsis: Laura Smyth is joined by comedians Sara Barron and Nish Kumar to hear about the indelible mark their mothers left on them.

new_series.title: Unspeakable
new_series.synopsis: Phil Wang and Susie Dent challenge guests to invent new words and help create the new ultimate Unspeakable dictionary. With guests Jessie Cave, Armando Iannucci and Chloe Petts.

new_series.title: Drama on 4
new_series.synopsis: A young conscript joins Alpha Company in Vietnam in 1969. Their aim? To survive. If they can. These are the stories of those who did.

new_series.title: Millionaire Hot Seat
new_series.synopsis: Jeremy Clarkson returns with the quiz as six more hopefuls compete for £1 million, with only one player at a time able to take a place in the Hot Seat and answer multiple-choice questions to work the way up the Money Ladder. Each question is against the clock and if a player gets one wrong they are eliminated, the top prize drops, and the next player takes their place.

new_series.title: The Box
new_series.synopsis: Joey Essex, John Bercow, Jenny Ryan, JB Gill, Danny Aarons, Ranvir Singh, Sara Davies, Graeme Souness, Ellie Taylor and Shakira Khan compete in high-pressure challenges as they try to avoid a head-to-head showdown in the Duel and becoming the first famous face to be sent packing.
